name: analytics-page-fix
goal: Analytics route loads reliably for large histories without HTTP 500

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Large analytics histories produce truncated JSON and HTTP 500; website must parse complete subprocess output.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: Real CLI fixture with 4000 events failed JSON parsing at 65536 bytes; unchanged route regression expected HTTP 200 and received 500. Inspected route-before.png.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: CLI awaits stdout write completion; website waits for subprocess close after streams drain.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Same large-response test passed; same browser route test passed HTTP 200. Inspected route-after.png showing Analytics scaffold; dashboard design remains blocked until Claude reset.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: Full check passed: 175 unit, 49 CLI E2E, 1 package, 85 report tests. Fixed bundled server HTTP 200 on port 5685 with real history; test-owned before/after screenshots inspected. Manual browser verification blocked by URL security policy. Fresh Jev review incomplete: missing project key. Dashboard visual work pending quota reset.
